verdict.rationale: The GitHub README says Codex can be installed in code editors including VS Code, Cursor, and Windsurf, and the MCP docs confirm a Codex IDE extension that shares configuration with the CLI and desktop app. Beyond confirming the extension exists, the evidence says little about the in-IDE experience. Missing for 10: documentation of the in-IDE chat interface itself, evidence of editor-context awareness (open files, selections) for contextual help, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the IDE extension.
